dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Kay, I gotta go find Hu Tao now. First stop, Wangsheng Funeral Parlor...

choices.text: I've released my Xiao Lantern, too.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Whoa, your Xiao Lantern is way up there! Hehe, I reckon all the wishes written on it are gonna come true for sure!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Catch ya later, oh and Happy Lantern Rite to you too! Shame Hu Tao's busy this year, I woulda loved to put on another show...
